# UI/UX Specification: Landing Dashboard & Slide-Out App Drawer

**Document Version:** 1.0  
**Status:** Draft for Review  
**Author:** System Architect  
**Reviewers:** Lead Architect, Product Lead  
**Date:** 2025-01-15  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

This specification defines the UI/UX architecture for the new **Landing Dashboard** (primary merchant home screen) and **Slide-Out App Drawer** (global navigation & app marketplace entry point). The design targets feature parity with **Clover** (dashboard widgets, app market access, multi-location selector) and **Square** (customizable tiles, quick actions, real-time metrics, dark mode).

**Scope:**
- Responsive dashboard (desktop, tablet, mobile)
- Slide-out app drawer (persistent left rail on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile)
- Widget system (configurable, role-aware, real-time)
- Theme support (light/dark, high contrast)
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)

**Out of Scope:** App marketplace browsing, onboarding flows, settings panels (referenced only for integration points).

---

## 2. Reference Analysis: Clover & Square

| Capability | Clover (Dashboard) | Square (Dashboard) | Parity Target |
|------------|-------------------|-------------------|---------------|
| **Layout** | Fixed 3-col grid, widget cards | Flexible masonry grid, drag-reorder | CSS Grid + drag-drop (dnd-kit) |
| **Widget Types** | Sales, Orders, Employees, Apps, Insights | Sales, Items, Team, Online, Marketing | 8 core widgets + extensible registry |
| **Customization** | Limited (show/hide) | Full drag-resize, per-location | Full drag-resize-persist per user+location |
| **App Access** | Top nav "Apps" → marketplace modal | Left rail "Apps" → slide panel | Slide-out drawer (persistent) |
| **Multi-Location** | Top-bar selector | Top-bar selector + location-aware data | Unified location context provider |
| **Real-Time** | Polling (30s) | WebSocket (live) | WebSocket + fallback polling |
| **Theme** | Light only | Light/Dark/System | Light/Dark/System + HC |
| **Accessibility** | Basic ARIA | WCAG 2.1 AA | WCAG 2.1 AA + keyboard shortcuts |
| **Quick Actions** | FAB (mobile only) | Floating "Create" button | Contextual FAB + keyboard `Cmd/Ctrl+K` |
| **Notifications** | Bell icon + badge | Bell icon + toast + in-app center | Unified notification center in drawer |

**Key Differentiators to Adopt:**
- Square's **masonry grid + drag-resize** for dashboard personalization
- Clover's **role-based widget visibility** (owner vs manager vs cashier)
- Square's **command palette** (`Cmd/Ctrl+K`) for power users
- Clover's **location-scoped data context** (critical for multi-location merchants)

## 3. Dashboard Specification

### 3.1 Layout & Breakpoints

| Breakpoint | Columns | Gutter | Margin | Drawer Behavior |
|------------|---------|--------|--------|-----------------|
| **Mobile** (< 640px) | 1 | 12px | 16px | Bottom sheet (full width) |
| **Tablet** (640–1024px) | 2 | 16px | 24px | Slide-over (320px) |
| **Desktop** (1024–1440px) | 3 | 20px | 32px | Persistent rail (280px) |
| **Wide** (> 1440px) | 4 | 24px | 40px | Persistent rail (320px) |

**Grid System:** CSS Grid with `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))` for masonry-like flow. Widgets define `grid-column: span N` and `grid-row: span M`.

### 3.3 Core Widget Catalog

| Widget ID | Title | Default Size | Data Source | Refresh | Roles | Config Options |
|-----------|-------|--------------|-------------|---------|-------|----------------|
| `sales-summary` | Sales Overview | 2×1 | `/api/v1/metrics/sales` | WS 5s | All | Date range, comparison period |
| `orders-feed` | Recent Orders | 2×2 | `/api/v1/orders/recent` | WS push | Owner, Manager | Status filters, max items |
| `top-items` | Top Selling Items | 2×1 | `/api/v1/items/top` | 30s poll | Owner, Manager | Period, limit (5/10/20) |
| `employee-status` | Team Status | 1×2 | `/api/v1/employees/status` | WS push | Owner, Manager | Show clocked-in only |
| `inventory-alerts` | Low Stock Alerts | 1×1 | `/api/v1/inventory/alerts` | 60s poll | Owner, Manager | Threshold, categories |
| `revenue-trend` | Revenue Trend | 2×2 | `/api/v1/metrics/revenue-trend` | 5min | Owner | Granularity (hour/day/week) |
| `quick-actions` | Quick Actions | 1×1 | Static config | N/A | All | Custom action links |
| `app-shortcuts` | App Shortcuts | 1×1 | `/api/v1/apps/installed` | On mount | All | Pinned apps (max 6) |
| `custom-kpi` | Custom KPI | 1×1 | `/api/v1/metrics/custom` | Config | Owner | Metric ID, format, target |

**Widget States:** `loading` → `ready` | `error` | `empty` | `stale` (WS disconnected)

### 3.4 Dashboard Personalization

- **Persisted per user + location** (localStorage + server sync)
- **Drag-to-reorder** (dnd-kit `@dnd-kit/core` + `@dnd-kit/sortable`)
- **Resize handles** (SE corner, `react-resizable-panels` or custom)
- **Add/Remove** via "Customize Dashboard" mode (FAB + `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E`)
- **Reset to defaults** action in overflow menu

### 3.5 Top Bar Component Spec

| Element | Spec |
|---------|------|
| **Hamburger Menu** | 44×44px touch target, `aria-label="Open navigation"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls="app-drawer"` |
| **Location Selector** | Combobox (Headless UI), shows location name + status badge, keyboard navigable |
| **Command Palette** | `Cmd/Ctrl+K` opens, fuzzy search widgets, actions, apps, settings |
| **Notifications** | Bell icon, badge count, click → Notification Center (drawer panel) |
| **Theme Toggle** | 3-state: Light / Dark / System, persists to `localStorage.theme` |
| **User Avatar** | Menu: Profile, Switch Account, Sign Out |

| **Tablet** | Slide-over panel | 320px | Hamburger | Backdrop click, swipe, ESC |

### 4.3 Navigation Items (Primary)

| Route | Icon | Label | Badge Source | Roles | Description |
|-------|------|-------|--------------|-------|-------------|
| `/dashboard` | Home | Dashboard | — | All | Landing dashboard |
| `/orders` | Package | Orders | `/api/v1/orders/count?status=open` | All | Order management |
| `/reports` | BarChart | Reports | — | Owner, Manager | Analytics & exports |
| `/customers` | Users | Customers | — | Owner, Manager | CRM |
| `/inventory` | Box | Inventory | `/api/v1/inventory/low-stock-count` | Owner, Manager | Stock management |
| `/team` | UserGroup | Team | `/api/v1/employees/pending-approvals` | Owner | Staff & permissions |

### 4.4 App Marketplace Section

- **Explore Apps** → routes to `/apps/marketplace` (full-page)
- **My Apps** → expandable list of installed apps (max 6 shown, "View All" link)
- Each app: icon, name, status badge (Active/Update/Error), quick-launch button

### 4.5 Notification Center (Drawer Panel)

- Slide-in panel from right (desktop) / full-screen (mobile)
- Tabs: All / Unread / Mentions / System
- Actions: Mark read, Archive, Deep-link to entity
- Real-time via WebSocket, fallback polling 30s

### 4.6 Collapsed State (Desktop Only)

- Width: 72px
- Icons only, tooltips on hover (`aria-label`)
- Hover/focus → temporary expand (320px) with smooth transition (200ms)
- Persisted preference: `localStorage.drawerCollapsed`

## 6. Data Flow

### 6.1 State Management Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        React Context Providers                    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  AuthProvider          → user, permissions, token               │
│  LocationProvider      → currentLocationId, locations[], switch │
│  ThemeProvider         → theme, resolvedTheme, toggleTheme      │
│  WebSocketProvider     → connectionStatus, subscribe/unsubscribe│
│  NotificationProvider  → notifications[], markRead, archive     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Zustand Stores (Client)                    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  useDashboardStore     → widgets[], editMode, layout, persist() │
│  useDrawerStore        → isOpen, variant, collapsed, activeTab  │
│  useCommandPaletteStore→ query, results, open, recentActions    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      TanStack Query (Server)                    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Widget Queries        → keyed by widgetId + locationId + params│
│  Navigation Badges     → prefetched, staleTime: 30s             │
│  App List              → installed apps, marketplace featured   │
│  User Preferences      → dashboard layout, drawer state         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 6.2 Real-Time Data Flow (WebSocket)

```
Server                          Client
  │                                │
  ├─ WS Connect (auth token) ────►│
  │                                │
  ├─ Subscribe: "metrics:sales" ──►│
  │                                │
  ├─ Event: {type: "SALES_UPDATE", │
  │         payload: {...}} ──────►│
  │                                │
  │         ◄─── QueryClient.setQueryData(['sales', locationId], newData)
  │                                │
  │         ◄─── Widget re-renders with fresh data
  │                                │
  ├─ Heartbeat (30s) ────────────►│
  │                                │
  └─ Reconnect (exponential backoff)
```

**Fallback:** If WS fails → TanStack Query `refetchInterval: 30000`

### 6.3 Dashboard Layout Persistence

```typescript
// Client → Server sync (debounced 1s)
interface DashboardLayout {
  userId: string;
  locationId: string;
  widgets: WidgetInstance[];
  updatedAt: ISOString;
}

// WidgetInstance
interface WidgetInstance {
  id: string;              // UUID
  widgetId: string;        // Registry key
  position: { x: number; y: number };
  size: { w: number; h: number };
  config: Record<string, any>;  // Per-widget config
  visible: boolean;
}
```

**Sync Strategy:**
- Local: `localStorage.dashboard:{userId}:{locationId}` (immediate)
- Server: `PATCH /api/v1/users/me/dashboard/{locationId}` (debounced, retry on failure)
- On load: Merge server + local (local wins for uncommitted changes)

### 7.2 Navigation Guards

| Guard | Purpose | Implementation |
|-------|---------|----------------|
| `requireAuth` | Redirect to `/login` if no session | `loader` checks `AuthProvider` |
| `requireRole(roles)` | 403 if insufficient role | `loader` checks `user.permissions` |
| `requireLocation` | Redirect to location selector | `loader` checks `LocationProvider` |
| `prefetchDashboard` | Pre-load widgets for instant paint | `loader` calls `queryClient.prefetchQuery` |

### 7.3 Deep Linking & State Preservation

- **Drawer state** not in URL (UI state only)
- **Dashboard edit mode** not in URL
- **Widget config modals** → `?widgetConfig=<widgetId>` (optional, for shareability)

## 8. Accessibility Requirements (WCAG 2.1 AA)

### 8.1 Keyboard Navigation

| Component | Keys | Behavior |
|-----------|------|----------|
| **Top Bar** | `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | Linear focus order |
| **Hamburger** | `Enter` / `Space` | Toggle drawer |
| **Command Palette** | `Cmd/Ctrl+K` | Open from anywhere |
| **Dashboard Grid** | `Arrow Keys` | Move focus between widgets |
| **Widget (Edit Mode)** | `Enter` | Open config; `Delete` → remove; `Arrow+Shift` → resize |
| **Drawer Nav** | `Arrow Up/Down` | Move between items; `Enter` → activate |
| **Drawer (Mobile)** | `ESC` | Close drawer |
| **Notification Center** | `Tab` | Trap focus within panel |

### 8.2 Screen Reader Support

- **Landmarks:** `<header>`, `<nav id="app-drawer">`, `<main>`, `<aside>` (notifications)
- **ARIA Labels:** All icon-only buttons have `aria-label`
- **Live Regions:** `aria-live="polite"` for sales updates, `aria-live="assertive"` for critical alerts
- **Widget Roles:** `role="region" aria-labelledby="widget-title-{id}"`
- **Drawer:** `aria-modal="true"` on mobile/tablet, `aria-hidden` on desktop when collapsed

### 8.3 Visual Accessibility

| Requirement | Spec |
|-------------|------|
| **Color Contrast** | 4.5:1 (text), 3:1 (UI components), 7:1 (AAA for key metrics) |
| **Focus Indicators** | 2px solid outline, offset 2px, `outline-color: var(--focus-ring)` |
| **Reduced Motion** | `@media (prefers-reduced-motion)` disables transitions, animations |
| **High Contrast Mode** | CSS `forced-colors: active` support, semantic borders |
| **Zoom** | Layout functional at 200% zoom (no horizontal scroll) |
| **Touch Targets** | Minimum 44×44px (mobile), 32×32px (desktop) |

### 8.4 Accessibility Testing Checklist

- [ ] axe-core automated scan (CI gate)
- [ ] Manual keyboard-only navigation test
- [ ] NVDA + Firefox / VoiceOver + Safari testing
- [ ] Color contrast audit (all themes)
- [ ] Focus order verification
- [ ] ARIA landmark validation
